neighbours.label: cryptography and data-security techniques: the token right after naming one (encryption, authentication, a cryptographic technique called ...)
fire: The service protects files with end-to-end encryption and two-factor authentication.
A cryptographic method called homomorphic encryption lets servers compute on hidden data.
Messages are signed with a private key and checked with the matching public key.
The vault stores passwords using salted hashes and AES encryption.
Researchers proposed a protocol based on zero-knowledge proofs for voting.
The phone supports hardware encryption, secure boot and remote wipe.
Emails can be encrypted with PGP before they leave the client.
The bank added digital signatures and certificate pinning to its app.
quiet: The service stores files in folders and sorts them by date.
A statistical method called linear regression lets analysts fit a line to data.
Messages are sent with a short delay and shown in the inbox.
The app stores recipes using tags and a simple search box.
Researchers proposed a schedule based on school holidays for voting.
The phone supports wireless charging, dual cameras and a large screen.
Emails can be scheduled before they leave the client.
The bank added a chat window and a dark mode to its app.
